Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center on July 16, 1969 at 13:32 UTC. The lunar module Eagle landed on the Moon at 20:17 UTC on July 20, 1969. Neil Armstrong stepped onto the lunar surface at 02:56 UTC on July 21, 1969. The mission splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on July 24, 1969, successfully returning the crew to Earth.
